full_text:
Article 7 (Requests for Cooperation from Relevant Institutions, etc.)
(1) Where necessary for the performance of its duties, the Committee may hear opinions from relevant experts or request cooperation from relevant administrative agencies and other institutions, corporations, organizations, etc., including the submission of materials or presentation of opinions.
(2) Where necessary for the performance of its duties, the Committee may commission relevant experts, institutions, corporations, or organizations to conduct investigations or research.
